title: parse_bcrypt_cost accepts out-of-range cost factors (0-3, >31)
description: parse_bcrypt_cost() in crates/auth/src/store.rs returns Some(cost) for any u32 parsed from the hash string, including cost=0, cost=1, cost=2, cost=3 (below bcrypt minimum of 4) and cost=99 (above bcrypt maximum of 31). A config entry like '$2b$01$...' passes the from_credentials() guard but make_dummy_hash() then calls bcrypt::hash with cost=1, which either panics or returns an error — a different panic path with a confusing message unrelated to the misconfiguration. The guard should also reject cost<4 or cost>31.
